summary_en: Nack completed acquisition of Yōkō, a Duskin franchise operator, through a simplified stock exchange on October 1, 2026. Yōkō became a wholly-owned subsidiary with no material impact on consolidated earnings expected.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Acquisition of Yōkō Co., Ltd. as Wholly-Owned Subsidiary through Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief:
On October 1, 2026, Nack completed a simplified stock exchange in which it became the wholly-owning parent company and Yōkō (Yōkō Co., Ltd.) became a wholly-owned subsidiary. The transaction was decided by Nack's board of directors on August 28, 2026, and approved by Yōkō's extraordinary shareholders meeting on the same date. As Nack was the acquiring company, the company law procedures for simplified stock exchange were applied, with a notice posted electronically from September 9, 2026. No objections to the transaction were filed.

Yōkō is a Duskin franchise operator headquartered in Ichihara, Chiba Prefecture, with capital of 20 million yen and established in December 1994. Following the completion of the stock exchange, Yōkō is now a 100% subsidiary of Nack.

Nack assessed that the stock exchange would have a minimal impact on its consolidated business results.
